description: This file defines a CachedTypeResolver class that extends TypeResolver to provide cached type resolution functionality within the Orleans.Serialization.TypeSystem namespace. It manages caches for types and assemblies, and provides methods to resolve types by name, including handling reflection-only types and assembly loading.

classes.name: CachedTypeResolver
classes.description: A sealed class that caches type resolution results to improve performance and reduce redundant reflection calls.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Retrieves the cached assembly name for a given Assembly object.

methods.name: ResolveType
methods.description: Resolves a type by name, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: TryResolveType
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a type by name, returning a boolean indicating success.

methods.name: TryPerformUncachedTypeResolution
methods.description: Performs type resolution without cache, searching through loaded assemblies and attempting to load the type.

methods.name: TryGetCachedType
methods.description: Checks if a type is present in the cache.

methods.name: AddTypeToCache
methods.description: Adds a resolved type to the cache.

methods.name: ResolveAssembly
methods.description: Resolves an assembly from an AssemblyName, loading it if necessary.

methods.name: ResolveType (static method)
methods.description: Resolves a type within an assembly, considering case sensitivity.
